question: Which was the first petrochemical company in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Petrochemicals Corporation Limited​.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian Petrochemicals Corporation Limited (IPCL) was established in **1969**.
 
• It was a joint venture between the **Government of India and the private sector company, AIC (American International Company).**
 
• The main objective of IPCL was to manufacture petrochemicals and chemicals for the domestic market as well as for exports.
 
• IPCL was merged with Reliance Industries Limited in 2007, making it the** largest petrochemical company in India** and one of the largest in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

​**Gas Authority of India Limited (GAIL) **

 
• It is a state-owned natural gas processing and distribution company.
 
• It was established in **1984 **and has since diversified into the petrochemicals, telecom, and power sectors.

**Haldia Petrochemicals Limited (HPL)**

 
• It is a joint venture between the **Government of West Bengal, The Chatterjee Group, and TATA Group**.
 
• It was established in 1994 and is located in Haldia, West Bengal. HPL produces a wide range of petrochemicals and is one of the largest manufacturers of polypropylene in India.

**National Organic Chemical Industry Limited (NOCIL)**

 
• It is a chemical manufacturing company that specializes in rubber chemicals, rubber intermediates, and speciality chemicals.
 
• It was established in **1961 **and is headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
